meta.title: Vendor who does not accept is knocked out
gaps: Configure and publish a live knockout auction with a current vendor offer.
As the vendor, click Not Accept on the knockout offer and verify that the vendor is absent from the bidders still in the running.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure and publish a live knockout auction with a current vendor offer.; As the vendor, click Not Accept on the knockout offer and verify that the vendor is absent from the bidders still in the running.

steps.note: Start the closest supported event-creation flow.
Create the RFQ required before conversion to an auction.
Apply the RFQ template before adding line items.
Add the required auction line item.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Publish the source RFQ so it can be converted.
Assert that the source event was published.
Reach the supported RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow, the only catalog route related to knockout auctions.
Assert that conversion itself completed without an application error.

args.need: configure and publish the converted event as a live knockout auction, sign in as the invited vendor, click Not Accept on the current offer, and verify the vendor is no longer among the bidders still in the running

steps.note: The knockout strategy, vendor Not Accept action, and running-bidder oracle have no catalog step.
